title: House approves OVP's P785.2-M budget for 2027 without interpellations
summary: The House of Representatives on early Tuesday terminated the plenary deliberations for the 2027 budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) without any interpellations.

blocks.text: The House of Representatives on early Tuesday terminated the plenary deliberations for the 2027 budget of the Office of the Vice President (OVP) without any interpellations.
ACT Teachers party-list Representative Antonio Tinio moved to terminate interpellations.
The OVP has proposed a P785.204-million budget for 2027, 11.7% lower than its P889.236-million appropriated budget for 2026.
It said this year's budget aims to support the agency's continued delivery of assistance and services to beneficiaries nationwide. — VDV, GMA News
